keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Shunsuke Mito (Sparta Rotterdam).
Delay in match because of an injury Pascal Mulder (ADO Den Haag).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, ADO Den Haag. Lasse Wilhelm replaces Pascal Mulder because of an injury.
Goal! ADO Den Haag 1, Sparta Rotterdam 0. Juho Kilo (ADO Den Haag) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Jalen Hawkins following a corner.
First Half ends, ADO Den Haag 1, Sparta Rotterdam 0.
